incoming.name: Switzerland
incoming.excerpt: The top executive body and collective Head of State is the Federal Council, a collegial body of seven members.

outgoing.name: 20th century
outgoing.excerpt: The process of involving all major political movements of Switzerland into the responsibility of government continued during the first half of the 20th century.

outgoing.name: Corporation
outgoing.excerpt: In that and other respects, the Council operates not unlike a board of directors of a major corporation.

outgoing.name: Euro
outgoing.excerpt: Federal Councillors draw a yearly remuneration of CHF 400,000 (circa EUR 256,000 / USD 305,000) .

outgoing.name: World War II
outgoing.excerpt: In 1943, during World War II, the Social Democrats were also temporarily included with Ernst Nobs.
